paper_metadata.title: Effect of late 3d transition metals (Co, Fe, Ni) combined with Ti or Al on the structure and mechanical properties of the Nb85Mo5Ta5V5 refractory complex concentrated alloy
paper_metadata.journal: International Journal of Refractory Metals and Hard Materials
